****


**SALT LAKE CITY — November 24, 2026 — ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK)** today announced that a frozen foods distributor has selected Touchless Retail™ to replace driver-performed merchandising with professional pack-out and light-touch services delivered by SPAR’s APEX merchandising team immediately following product deliveries.


Under this approach, delivery drivers can drop off products and move directly to their next stop, while APEX merchandisers follow behind to stock freezer cases, replenish displays and ensure products are ready for shoppers. This coordinated execution reduces driver time in stores, improves route efficiency and maintains product availability without delaying merchandising.


Touchless Retail delivers these services at approximately 50% less than traditional hourly merchandising costs, using only the top 10% of merchandisers, with a 99%+ on-time and show-up rate and less than 0.5% rework.


“Every minute a frozen foods driver spends merchandising inside a store is time that could be spent making another delivery,” said Randy Fields, chairman and CEO of ReposiTrak. “With Touchless Retail, our APEX merchandisers work directly behind the delivery vehicle, getting products into freezer cases while drivers move on to their next stop. It’s better route efficiency, professional merchandising and roughly half the traditional cost.”


The distributor will utilize two core Touchless Retail services:


- Pack-Out Merchandising: APEX merchandisers follow deliveries to unpack and stock products in designated freezer cases and displays, ensuring products are properly positioned and available for purchase.
- Light-Touch Merchandising: Maintaining product presentation, rotating inventory, identifying out-of-stocks and replenishing freezer cases and displays as needed.


For frozen foods distributors, separating delivery and merchandising responsibilities addresses a longstanding operational challenge. Drivers often spend significant time inside stores stocking products, extending routes and limiting the number of deliveries they can complete.


By scheduling APEX merchandising immediately behind deliveries, distributors can increase driver productivity while maintaining consistent, high-quality in-store execution. The fixed-cost model also provides predictable merchandising expenses without the higher costs of traditional hourly services.


Touchless Retail supports a wide range of direct store delivery (DSD) categories and can be deployed independently of ReposiTrak’s Scan-based Trading (SBT 2.0) solution.


**About ReposiTrak** ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK) is an AI-powered, integrated platform that connects retailers, wholesalers, suppliers, and food manufacturers through a suite of applications designed to reduce risk, support regulatory compliance, strengthen operational controls, and protect brand integrity. The ReposiTrak platform serves as a shared system of record across its solution areas, maintaining and synchronizing complex supplier and customer data to enable secure, accurate, and scalable information exchange.


ReposiTrak’s solutions are organized into three core product families: traceability, compliance and risk management, and supply chain solutions. Through its scalable, cloud-based platform and U.S.-based team of experts, the Company helps organizations streamline operations, improve data transparency, and meet evolving regulatory requirements across the food supply chain.


For more information, visit[www.repositrak.com](https://www.repositrak.com/) .


**About SPAR Group** SPAR Group is a merchandising and retail services company providing in-store merchandising, product resets, remodels, and other retail execution services. Its field teams support retailers and consumer brands in improving product presentation, implementing merchandising programs, and maintaining consistent execution across retail locations.
